corpusTitle: The Meridian Lighthouse & The Brass Chronometer (Narrative Prose)

sentenceTemplates.rawText: Before the winter gale struck the northern promontory, the old horologist wound the brass chronometer inside the basalt tower.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: before the winter gale struck the northern promontory, the old horologist wound the brass chronometer inside the basalt tower.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: The brass chronometer governed the rotating prism at the summit of the lighthouse.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: the brass chronometer governed the rotating prism at the summit of the lighthouse.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: Whenever the rotating prism aligned with the narrow harbor channel, a focused amber beam pierced the coastal fog.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: whenever the rotating prism aligned with the narrow harbor channel, a focused amber beam pierced the coastal fog.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: Captain Helena stood on the wet quarterdeck of the schooner and watched the focused amber beam sweep across the black water.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: captain helena stood on the wet quarterdeck of the schooner and watched the focused amber beam sweep across the black water.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: She trusted the horologist because the brass chronometer never drifted during the equinox.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: she trusted the horologist because the brass chronometer never drifted during the equinox.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: Inside the basalt tower, the apprentice Elena recorded the pendulum oscillations in a leather ledger.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: inside the basalt tower, the apprentice elena recorded the pendulum oscillations in a leather ledger.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: When a sudden lightning bolt shattered the outer copper conductor, the iron weights trembled above the stone stairwell.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: when a sudden lightning bolt shattered the outer copper conductor, the iron weights trembled above the stone stairwell.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: Elena released the auxiliary escapement lever before the rotating prism could stall.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: elena released the auxiliary escapement lever before the rotating prism could stall.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: The auxiliary escapement lever restored the steady cadence of the brass chronometer.
sentenceTemplates.charSequence: the auxiliary escapement lever restored the steady cadence of the brass chronometer.

sentenceTemplates.rawText: At dawn the schooner glided safely through the narrow harbor channel while the coastal fog dissolved into silver mist.
